message.reasoning_content: The compiled code uses `$.attribute_effect(select, ...)` with spread — when spreading, Svelte likely resets select value/attributes. Likely the fix in svelte source: when spreading onto a select, the runtime shouldn't clear the selected state, or should handle select specially. Find the spread code in packages/svelte/src/internal/client/dom/elements/attributes.js.

The bug: after spreading on select, the final `effect` calls `select_option(select, prev.value)` where prev.value is undefined, setting selectedIndex = -1, clearing the selected option. Without spread, that effect never runs. Fix: only call select_option if 'value' in prev. Also init_select triggers observer. Let me record hypotheses.
